props.name: href
props.description: Builds the href for a page number. `$p` is replaced with the page.

props.name: siblings
props.description: How many page numbers to show between the ellipses. Small enough that the row never wraps on a 320px viewport.

ai.summary: Moves between pages of a list, with a window around the current page.
whenToUse: A list is split into numbered pages
The reader needs to jump to a known page, not just the next one
The total number of pages is known
whenNotToUse: Items load as you scroll — use infinite scrolling instead
There are only two or three pages — Prev/Next alone is less to read
The pages are steps in a process — use a Stepper
ai.accessibility: `<nav>` with an accessible name, and page numbers are links because a page is a destination — a `<button>` would misdescribe navigation as an action. The current page carries `aria-current="page"` and is not a link. The ellipsis is empty and `aria-hidden`, so it is not announced as a stop and cannot take focus. Prev and Next carry visually hidden words, because "‹" alone announces as punctuation.
knownLimitations: The window is computed here; `siblings` controls how many pages sit either side
Without an `href` template the component handles the navigation and emits `sk-page-change`; with one, the links are real and the browser navigates
